versions.changelog:
- Added Bash script claw-openwebui.sh for direct shell usage and automation.
- Expanded installation and usage instructions to include both OpenClaw natural language commands and new Bash command-line examples.
- Updated documentation to reflect Bash usage and clarify setup steps.
- Changed skill author to kuanlin.huang and incremented version to 1.0.3.

- Author name updated from 南極磷蝦 to Ken.
- Version number updated to 1.0.2.
- Unified variable and path formatting by adding extra backslashes for escaping.
- Minor edits to example values and comments for clarity.
- No changes to functionality or API usage.

- No functional changes; documentation formatting and minor text adjustments only.
- Installation section was removed from the documentation.
- Example default host/IP changed from LAN IP to localhost (127.0.0.1) in some config code blocks.
- No code or feature changes in this release.

- Initial release of Claw_OpenWebUI_API.
- Integrates Open WebUI RAG knowledge base API for automatic file upload and knowledge retrieval.
- Provides scripts to upload documents, search the knowledge base, and enhanced chat features using knowledge base content.
- Requires environment variables OPENWEBUI_URL and OPENWEBUI_API_KEY.
- Supports various document formats, including PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, TXT, and Markdown.
